title: cc_common.configure_features without cpp fragment crashes

labels.name: P2
labels.description: We'll consider working on this in future. (Assignee optional)

body:
```
$ cat my-rule.bzl
load("@bazel_tools//tools/cpp:toolchain_utils.bzl", "find_cpp_toolchain")

def _my_rule(ctx):
    tc = find_cpp_toolchain(ctx)
    f = cc_common.configure_features(ctx = ctx, cc_toolchain = tc)

my_rule = rule(
    implementation = _my_rule,
    attrs = {
        "_cc_toolchain": attr.label(default = Label("@bazel_tools//tools/cpp:current_cc_toolchain")),
    },
)
$ cat BUILD
load(":my-rule.bzl", "my_rule")
my_rule(name = "x")
$ bazel build //:x
```
